overview.description: The Roundhill NVDA WeeklyPay ETF (NVDW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of Nvidia stock (NVDA). NVDW was launched on Feb 19, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
